items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Tom and them couldn't come and asked me could I get a band. I told him yeah. And we was, I said, young Sam Morgan band. And we went over there and from that on, we just kept a going on there.

ctx.x: Well, his daddy was playing bass violin and old Tom Albin on Begundry and St. Peter. Tom used to be his trumpet player. And they always wanted to carry me over there. And they carried me to Passpegoula. That's the first time I had a chance to get over there. And after I got over there once, then this, the fellow was running the pressing shop. He seen me. And Tom and them couldn't come and asked me could I get a band. I told him yeah. And we was, I said, young Sam Morgan band. And we went over there and from that…
I wondered in 1915 when you moved up here, who the best trumpet players were in the carnet, on the carnet in this city. Do you remember Oliver or Kepard or anybody like that?
